links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across three repeated runs at temperature 0
links.effect: Reproducibility exceeded 95% for most models, but some residual non-determinism remained even with greedy decoding (temperature=0).
links.quote: Reproducibility exceeded 95% for most models; however, some residual non-determinism appeared even with greedy decoding (temperature=0).

screen.reason: The study is an automated benchmark evaluating the performance and reproducibility of 12 commercial LLMs on Korean residency examination questions in laboratory medicine without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
